say:2:1041534601:1.text: Look at this place! It's practically buzzing with Winter Carnival vibes! The lights, the food, the drink... it's perfect!
say:2:1041534601:1.source_cn: 看，这里完全变了个模样！充满了隆冬节的氛围！

say:3:1041534602:1.text: Talene, have you ever heard the legend behind the Winter Carnival?
say:3:1041534602:1.source_cn: 你听说过他们对于隆冬节的传说吗，塔琳？

say:4:1041534603:1.text: I'm familiar with the story. It's filled with beauty and virtue.
say:4:1041534603:1.source_cn: 当然，我喜欢一切浪漫与美丽的故事。

say:5:1041534604:1.text: The evil Hypogeans cast their curse over the land, drowning the world in eternal cold and darkness...
say:5:1041534604:1.source_cn: 可憎的恶魔诅咒了大地，让世界陷入无尽的严寒与黑夜！

say:6:1041534605:1.text: Until the stars themselves fell, lighting up the sky with fire and warmth!
say:6:1041534605:1.source_cn: 直到灿烂的星辰从天而降，带来了火焰与光明。

say:7:1041534606:1.text: What a romantic story. I've dreamed since childhood of becoming that star. How wonderful it would be!
say:7:1041534606:1.source_cn: 多么浪漫的故事，我从小做梦都在想，如果我能化为那颗星星...

say:8:1041534607:1.text: Uh... usually, childhood dreams of the Winter Carnival involve receiving gifts at night, right?
say:8:1041534607:1.source_cn: ……呃，一般来说，小时候的隆冬节梦想，应该是晚上收到什...

say:9:1041534608:1.text: Of course, there's also the grand banquet filled with fine wine and delicious food! Along with the dazzling lights and the upcoming ball!
say:9:1041534608:1.source_cn: 当然，还有充满了醇酒与美食的盛大晚宴！以及华丽的灯光与...

say:10:1041534609:1.text: Most people treat this as a special annual celebration. Then again, when your life is a constant feast of wine, food, and parties, I suppose every day is a celebration, isn't it, Dionel?
say:10:1041534609:1.source_cn: 我倒是觉得对有些人来说，这压根谈不上隆冬节的梦想，而是...
